task_definition.task_name: Estimate Magnitude of Completeness using Kolmogorov–Smirnov Method

task_description.overview: Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by comparing the observed cumulative distribution of magnitudes to an exponential model using the Kolmogorov–Smirnov distance and a probabilistic threshold.
steps: Load the earthquake catalog containing event magnitudes.
Set the magnitude bin width (Δm) and KS test parameters: probability threshold p and number of random draws n.
For each candidate Mc, simulate n magnitude samples from an exponential distribution truncated at Mc.
Compute the KS distance between the observed cumulative distribution and the simulated distribution.
Determine the smallest Mc for which the probability of observing a KS distance exceeds p.
Return the estimated Mc and diagnostic information (tested b-values, KS distances).

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) method. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {delta_m}, and apply the K-S method to estimate the magnitude of completeness Mc (`cat.estimate_mc_ks()`). Report the estimated Mc and additional information (tested b-values, KS distances), plot a figure to show the magnitude of completeness. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary is usefule for catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please using or refer to the provided functions in `seismostats` 
 2) Save the mc data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content} and the mc plot to {result_plot}.
